evidence.intree_statement: Definition Monadic {C D : Category} (U : C ⟶ D) : Type := ∃ (F : D ⟶ C) (A : F ⊣ U), EquivalenceOfCategories (EM_Comparison A).

Definition crude_monadicity : EquivalenceOfCategories (EM_Comparison A) := {| quasi_inverse := Crude_Inverse; equivalence_counit := crude_equivalence_counit; equivalence_unit := crude_equivalence_unit |}.  (the adjunction-level form of monadicity, in force throughout Monad/Monadicity/ and Monad/Lifting.v)

Definition EM_Comparison : C ⟶ @EilenbergMoore D (U ◯ F) Adjunction_Induced_Monad := ... (fun c => (U c; EM_Comparison_Algebra c)) ... — the canonical comparison into the algebras of the induced monad T = U ◯ F

statement_record.book: Definition 5.3.1: an adjunction F -| U : D -> C is MONADIC if the canonical comparison functor K : D -> C^T of Proposition 5.2.13, into the category of algebras for the induced monad T = UF, is an EQUIVALENCE of categories; a functor U : D -> C is monadic if it admits a left adjoint whose adjunction is monadic.
statement_record.intree: Definition Monadic {C D : Category} (U : C ⟶ D) : Type := ∃ (F : D ⟶ C) (A : F ⊣ U), EquivalenceOfCategories (EM_Comparison A).
statement_record.strength_comparison: same. Riehl's two clauses are both in force: the functor clause is named ([Monadic U], existentially quantifying a left adjoint exactly as the book does), and the adjunction clause is the unnamed proposition [EquivalenceOfCategories (EM_Comparison A)] that the monadicity theorems produce and Monad/Lifting.v consumes (crude_monadicity, Monad/Monadicity/Beck.v). The comparison used is the one of Prop 5.2.13 with the book's formula K d = (U d, U eps_d), landing in the algebras of Adjunction_Induced_Monad, the transparent packaging of T = U ◯ F with ret = eta and join = U eps F. EquivalenceOfCategories is the quasi-inverse-with-natural-isomorphisms notion (Theory/Equivalence.v), the standard reading of 'equivalence of categories'. Note: the book's stronger unnumbered variant 'strictly monadic' (comparison an ISOMORPHISM of categories) is a separate inventory item and is not defined in-tree.
